evidence: --[p486]-- there will be 3 moles of O3 required to oxidize 1 mole of photoresist. At 100% efficiency, the oxidation power will be: 0.035/3 = 0.0117 M/min. This equates to approximately 12 min. of processing time to fully oxidize the photoresist (0.14/0.0117). --[p487]-- If we assume that oxidation efficiency is 50% for that system (due to the high level of dissolved ozone that was achieved) --[p487]-- Oxidation power = 0.5×0.0117 = 0.006 M/min. Time required to oxidize un-ashed wafers = 0.14 / 0.006 ≈ 24 min. Time required to oxidize ashed wafers = 0.007 / 0.006 ≈ 1.2 min.

query: HF气相刻BPSG相对热氧的选择比能做到多少(按45℃以上两档速率算)?另外书上建议这个工艺往哪个操作区间调才能稳定复现?
gold_standard: 45℃以上热氧化硅<25 Å/min、BPSG>5000 Å/min,故选择比 = 5000/25 = 200以上;操作区间:气相刻蚀区典型速率0~400 Å/min、刻蚀速率在35 Torr以下与HF分压成正比(250 Torr总压下饱和于约70 Å/min),该书建议采用高流量、低压力,使工艺处于表面反应控制区,以获得比传质控制区更好的复现性。
success_criteria: 算出选择比≥200(5000/25),并答出高流量低压力/表面反应控制区的操作建议。
evidence: --[p439]-- The etching rate of thermal oxide is less than 25 Å/min at a temperature above 45 ℃ while BPSG is etched at a rate of more than 5,000 Å/min. --[p438]-- The etching rate in this regime is usually low (typically 0~400 Å/min) compared to that of the condensed regime. --[p439]-- This implies that the HF vapor process should be operated at a high flow rate and low pressure to insure operation in the surface reaction limited regime. The surface reaction limited regime is probably more reproducible than the mass transfer limited regime.
